D6a-14 the room selection rule for form D, stated before any room is read. D keeps splits below it (room-forms-names.md; D's account section 14): D.1, keeping with the call (54 defining rooms); D.2.1, the play, carried on (27); D.2.2, the play, kept (15). These three leaves partition D's 96 defining rooms, and the gloss says help and carrying on are held by different rooms. So, as for B's facets, I take one room per leaf (my licence; J's words ask for representative and rich rooms of the form, and a form with kept splits is represented by each of its parts). A room's leaf is the prefix of its address in room-forms-tree-rooms.tsv. For each leaf, the candidates are the leaf's defining rooms whose distance to D's centre (the allocation's columns, _analysis/d4a08_embed.py, as D5 measured it) is at or below the median of D's 96 defining distances (the nearer half, as for B's parts), and which lie nearer D's centre than any other form's. Rank: selected changes (most first), coded concepts (most first), distance (nearest first); take the first. If a leaf has no candidate, the same rule is run on the leaf's defining rooms nearer D's centre than any other form's with no limit on distance, and the log says so. No room's record, lines or A1 telling is read before the three are chosen; the selection is by script (_analysis/d6a14_select_D.py).
